content:
Nora Patel: Postmortem follow-up: vendor cascade (cloud region flake -> model-registry auth thrash). Creating thread to lock owners and deadlines.
Ben Holt: I'll drive the remediation tracker. Proposed actions: 1) short auth fallback; 2) rotate token cadence + audit; 3) multi-region routing + vendor escalation update; 4) recurring synthetic load test.
Yara Singh: I can own #1 (auth fallback). Plan: edge-proxy will cache a fallback token for 90s and expose ff.edge_auth_fallback. PR + tests by Tue EOD. Implementation pseudo: 
```
if auth_check() == 200:
  forward()
else:
  forward_with_cached_token()
```
Will notify oncall when feature enabled.
Chris O'Neill: I'll take #2 and #4. Token cadence: rotate at 70% TTL; add a CI audit that fails PRs with tokens nearing expiry. For synthetic tests: weekly Tue 03:30 UTC run that simulates auth latency + 2x QPS for 20m. I'll create the run and own the monitoring alerts.
OpsBot: Incident IR-2026-049 logged: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-049. Impact: ~0.9% traffic, ~40m duration. Runbook seed: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/vendor-cascade-mitigation.
Nora Patel: Owners recap: Yara -> auth fallback (PR Tue); Chris -> rotation + synthetic (run by next Tue); Ben -> vendor escalation + SLA doc edits (EOW). I'll add entries to tracker doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-remediate-2026 and start a weekly 10m sync on Fridays.
Yara Singh: Quick note: ensure fallback doesn't bypass RBAC checks for admin endpoints. Will add scope guard in proxy.
Chris O'Neill: For monitoring, alert: model_registry.auth_fail_rate > 0.5% for 4m -> page SRE and execute canary routing rule. I'll add playbook links.
Ben Holt: Legal and account teams will be looped for vendor escalation contacts. Adding task.
Nora Patel: Acceptance criteria: fallback merged behind flag + canary shows reduced impact in fail scenario, rotation runbook dry-run in staging, vendor escalation contacts added, and synthetic scheduled. After completion we'll run a 90min cross-team drill.
Yara Singh: I'll post PR link and tests here once ready.
Chris O'Neill: Will post alert IDs and synthetic job link.
Ben Holt: Tracking doc updated. Will ping on Friday sync.
Nora Patel: Thanks all, closing thread for action updates — post final links here when done. :white_check_mark:
